clique_search: deterministic greedy from every starting vertex; valid clique only, not claimed maximum
primary_endpoints: random versus insertion ordering successes on the same partition
purpose: New-seed validation of the frozen color-order construction and independent matching lower bounds; separate from timed SAT/ILP experiments.
reporting: Retain disconnected graphs, all failures, all parameter pairs and all methods. Keep structural stress cases separate. No outcome-based filtering or retuning. Multiple parameters share a graph and are not independent samples. The protocol is locally fixed, not externally preregistered.
timing_scope: descriptive single-run wall time only; attempt counts are not equal time budgets
